figurative_meaning_bn: হিন্দুমতে সাদর সংবর্ধনা জ্ঞাপক ফুল ও চন্দন
figurative_meaning_en: In Hindu tradition, flowers and sandalwood as symbols of respectful welcome and blessing
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠানে সকলকে ফুলচন্দন দিয়ে সংবর্ধনা করা হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: May flowers and sandalwood adorn your face.
At the wedding ceremony, everyone was welcomed with flowers and sandalwood.
history: In Hindu rituals, flowers and sandalwood are traditionally used for tilak (forehead mark) and as offerings to deities, symbolizing purity and auspiciousness.
note: Often used in blessings to wish prosperity and honor.
